### capability-translate-domain-errors
## Translate domain errors

Maps DomainError codes to stable HTTP statuses and JSON error bodies while preserving a 404 route\_not\_found response for unmatched routes.

Claims:
- [claim-http-error-mapping](claims/p-2264e626255c-001.md#claim-claim-http-error-mapping)
